description: Test suite for file handling functionalities in the Mattermost server, including file upload, download, zip creation, permission filtering, and search integration.

methods.name: TestGeneratePublicLinkHash
methods.description: Tests the hash generation for public links, ensuring consistency and uniqueness with different salts and filenames.

methods.name: TestDoUploadFile
methods.description: Tests uploading files with various timestamps and path formats, verifying correct path generation and cleanup.

methods.name: TestUploadFile
methods.description: Tests the upload process with invalid and valid channel IDs, ensuring proper error handling and path assignment.

methods.name: TestParseOldFilenames
methods.description: Validates parsing of old filename formats, ensuring only valid paths are parsed and invalid ones are ignored.

methods.name: TestGetInfoForFilename
methods.description: Checks retrieval of file info for a filename, expecting nil for non-existent files.

methods.name: TestFindTeamIdForFilename
methods.description: Verifies team ID lookup based on filename, including cases where team is found or not.

methods.name: TestMigrateFilenamesToFileInfos
methods.description: Tests migration of filename paths to file info objects, including validation of path sanitization.

methods.name: TestWriteZipFile
methods.description: Verifies creation of zip archives with no files, one file, and multiple files, checking content and structure.

methods.name: TestCopyFileInfos
methods.description: Tests copying file info objects, ensuring new IDs and cleared post IDs.

methods.name: TestGenerateThumbnailImage
methods.description: Tests thumbnail image generation from a dummy image, verifying file creation and size.

methods.name: TestSearchFilesInTeamForUser
methods.description: Tests searching files within a team for a user, including database fallback and Elasticsearch mock scenarios.

methods.name: TestExtractContentFromFileInfo
methods.description: Ensures images are not processed for content extraction.

methods.name: TestGetLastAccessibleFileTime
methods.description: Checks retrieval of last accessible file time from system store, including error scenarios.

methods.name: TestComputeLastAccessibleFileTime
methods.description: Verifies updating or removing last accessible file time based on cloud limits and license.

methods.name: TestSetFileSearchableContent
methods.description: Tests setting searchable content for a file and subsequent search results.

methods.name: TestPermanentDeleteFilesByPost
methods.description: Verifies deletion of files associated with a post, including non-existent and empty file list cases.

methods.name: TestFilterFilesByChannelPermissions
methods.description: Tests filtering files based on user permissions in channels, including guest and non-existent channel scenarios.
